privacy.reason_for_default_on: per-clip fragility readouts drive the per-target verdict + the clip history shown in the calibration recordings UI — the feature's whole purpose

description: Per-clip fragility readings (one entry per clip × probe-run): outcome (held/fragile/fails_clean), fall SNR, per-word confuser, the model version it ran on. Append-only history keyed by clip file; the per-target verdict is derived from these.
